subject: Re: cups
body:
hey, Dana here, I run ops at Sweet Basin Creamery. we've got 14 shops across Utah and Idaho and our current cup vendor has honestly been a mess this year.

looking at ~150k 16oz cups for the season starting in May. need our exact brand colors matched (PMS 2347 C and black). could also do 8oz later in the year.

who do I talk to about pricing? no rush, just send something over when you can.

- Dana
needs_human_reason: Estimated order value $10,900-$16,650 is over $5,000 (rule 1). Delivery split across 14 shops isn't covered by the KB (rule 7).
summary: 14-shop chain (UT/ID) unhappy with its current vendor wants ~150k 16 oz cups, PMS 2347 C + black, for a May season start. Overseas $10,900 (lands late May) vs USA $16,650 (ready early April).
draft_reply:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for thinking of us. For ~150,000 16 oz cups with an exact PMS 2347 C + black match, you have two good options: $10,900.00 overseas or $16,650.00 from our USA partner. The right one depends on how early in May you need cups in hand.

Option 1: Overseas (offset), best price
150,000 x $0.07 = $10,500.00
Setup: $400.00 flat
Freight: free (lower 48)
Total: $10,900.00
Lead time: 10-12 weeks after proof approval, ocean freight included. With the proof approved this week, that's roughly May 18 - June 1.

Option 2: USA partner (flexographic), faster
150,000 x $0.109 = $16,350.00
Setup: 2 colors x $150 = $300.00
Freight: free (lower 48)
Total: $16,650.00
Lead time: 3-4 weeks after proof approval, so they'd ship around early April, well ahead of May.

Both include Pantone matching. Because this is a big order across 14 locations, our owner will personally follow up to work through delivery details and the 8 oz cups you mentioned for later in the year.

To keep things moving, send your logo as a vector file (AI, EPS, PDF, or SVG) and where the cups should ship. A 50% deposit starts production and the balance is due before shipping. Quotes are estimates, good for 30 days, and don't include sales tax.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: 'Season starting in May' read as need-by 2027-05-01; the overseas window misses early May but lands late May.
'Re: cups' subject, but there's no prior order history, so treated as a new prospect.
owner_note: Biggest opportunity in the inbox: a 14-shop chain frustrated with its current vendor. Overseas saves about $5,750 but arrives late May; USA is ready early April. Worth a personal call.
